purpose: Teach: レフ/栄養素/ボーイング

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、現場撮影でレフ、つまりレフ板を、警察、ご使用ですね
lines.en: So for crime-scene photography, you use refs — reflector boards, I mean — is that right?
lines.style: Polite fascinated confirmation; careful pace, checking his understanding with a respectful rising finish.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者の栄養素摂取状況も、警察、医師と確認されますね
lines.en: And you go over the victim's nutrient intake with the doctors as well, don't you.
lines.style: Slower, careful respect for the sensitive topic; hushed even tone, tactfully softened phrasing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、ボーイング社製の機体事故捜査もされますね
lines.en: You even handle accident investigations for Boeing-built aircraft, I take it.
lines.style: Small impressed intake of breath first; measured wonder, slight lift on the aircraft mention.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署内食堂の栄養素管理もされますね
lines.en: And even the station cafeteria gets its nutrition properly managed, doesn't it.
lines.style: Lighter conversational aside; faint amusement warming the politeness, easy relaxed pace throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、現場撮影のレフ機材を、警察、点検されますね
lines.en: And the reflector equipment for scene photography — you inspect all of that too, don't you.
lines.style: Wrapping-up admiration; gentle slowing, a final nod of respect in the closing tone.
